subject: DI03009011

title.en: 1.1 Electrical wire and cable:definitions and types

h.en: Electrical wire and cable:definitions and types

body.en:
Definition

A wire is a metallic conductor, bare or insulated,used to carry current.A cable is a manufactured assembly of one or more insulated conductors with the specified protective layers for a defined service.

Explanation and application

  • Classify by copper/aluminium,solid/stranded/flexible,core count,insulation,screen/armour,voltage and installation duty.One-core cable is still a cable.
  • Conductor area in mm²is not diameter in mm and not the insulated outside diameter used for conduit fill.Flexible strands require suitable terminals/ferrules and manufacturer methods.
  • PVC,XLPE,FR,FRLSand HFFRdescribe different material/fire-performance features;verify the complete standard/rating and manufacturer data rather than assuming all are equivalent.
  • Protective-conductor identity,function and continuity must be verified;colour alone cannot prove dead,correct polarity or a safe PEconnection.
Wire area equals diameter?

No;mm²area,mmmetal diameter and insulated outside diameter are different.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Wire એ current વહન કરતો bare કે insulated metallic conductor છે.Cable એ specified service માટે એક કે વધુ insulated conductors/protective layersનું manufactured assembly છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Copper-aluminium,solid-stranded-flexible,cores,insulation,screen-armour,V/installationથી વર્ગીકરણ કરો.Single-core પણ cable છે.
  • mm² conductor area,mm diameter અને insulated outside diameter અલગ છે.Conduit fillમાં outside diameter લો.Flexible strandsમાં યોગ્ય terminal-ferrule/method જોઈએ.
  • PVC,XLPE,FR,FRLS/HFFR અલગ material-fire features છે.Full standard-rating/data ચકાસો;બધું equivalent નધારો.
  • Protective conductorની identity,function/continuity verify કરો.Colourથી dead,polarity/PE safety સાબિત નથી થતી.
Wire Area એટલે Diameter?

નહિ.mm²area,mmmetal diameter/insulated OD અલગ છે.

body.en:
Definition

A surface wiring system encloses insulated conductors in a mounted channel closed by a fitted cover called capping.

Classification / representative type

  • Wiring systems include casing-capping and conduit;first choose permitted environment,mechanical/fire duty and accessibility.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Base casing provides the conductor channel and mounting surface;partitions/fittings separate routes where required.
  2. Insulated wires,junction boxes,bends,tees and outlet accessories form a complete accessible route.
  3. Secure capping,supports and compatible fittings retain conductors without crushing insulation or exposing live parts.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. The designed route carries separately identified circuit conductors from the DBto switches/outlets.
  2. The channel provides specified mechanical enclosure while wire insulation provides electrical separation.
  3. Accessible boxes permit approved joints/inspection;route capacity and environment determine allowable use.

Limitations and safety

Not every plastic channel is suitable for every location;no joints hidden behind inaccessible covers or improvised live extension.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Surface પર mounted channelમાં insulated conductors રાખી fitted coverથી બંધ કરાતી system casing-capping wiring છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Systemsમાં casing-capping/conduit આવે.પહેલાં environment,mechanical-fire duty/accessibility પસંદ કરો.

Construction — ભાગ તથા કામ

  1. Base casing channel/mounting આપે.Partition-fittings જરૂરી separation આપે.
  2. Insulated wires,boxes,bends,tees/outletsથી complete accessible route બને.
  3. Secure cover/supports compatible fittingsથી insulation crush કર્યા વિના wires પકડે/live exposure ટાળે.

Working — ક્રમ તથા કારણ

  1. Route DBથી switches-outlets સુધી identified conductors લઈ જાય.
  2. Channel mechanical enclosure આપે;wire insulation electrical separation આપે.
  3. Accessible boxes approved joint-inspection આપે.Capacity/environment ઉપયોગ નક્કી કરે.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

દરેક plastic channel દરેક જગ્યાએ યોગ્ય નથી.Inaccessible hidden joints/live extension નકરો.

body.en:
Definition

A wiring system routes insulated conductors through designed tubes and fittings that provide mechanical protection and an organised pathway.

Classification / representative type

  • Classify surface/concealed and metallic/nonmetallic;conduit selection depends on environment,strength,fire duty and bonding requirements.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Conduit sections,bends,couplers and bushes form a smooth pathway with protected entry edges.
  2. Pull/junction boxes and supports provide access and mechanical restraint;their locations must be coordinated with the building.
  3. Conductors,approved terminals and continuous PE/bonding complete the circuit;metal conduit continuity is verified,not assumed.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. The route is surveyed and specified before quantity take-off,including bends,risers and accessible boxes.
  2. Conductor outside diameters determine fill;inside conduit diameter,bends and pulling conditions determine practical capacity.
  3. Electrical insulation separates live conductors;enclosures/bonding/protection together manage mechanical damage and fault risk.

Limitations and safety

An empty conduit estimate is not a complete wiring estimate.Do not chase structural elements or pull wires through live installations.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Designed tubes/fittingsમાંથી insulated conductors route કરી mechanical protection/pathway આપતી system conduit wiring છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Surface-concealed/metallic-nonmetallic classify કરો.Environment,strength,fire/bondingથી પસંદ કરો.

Construction — ભાગ તથા કામ

  1. Sections,bends,couplers/bushes smooth pathway/entry-edge protection આપે.
  2. Pull-junction boxes/supports access/restraint આપે.Location building સાથે coordinate કરો.
  3. Conductors,terminals/continuous PE-bonding circuit complete કરે.Metal conduit continuity verify કરો,ધારો નહીં.

Working — ક્રમ તથા કારણ

  1. Quantity પહેલાં bends,risers/boxes સાથે route specify કરો.
  2. Wire outside diameterથી fill નક્કી થાય.Conduit inside diameter,bends/pulling capacity મર્યાદિત કરે.
  3. Insulation live conductors અલગ રાખે.Enclosure,bonding/protection damage/fault risk manage કરે.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

ફક્ત conduit estimate complete wiring નથી.Structure damage/live installationમાં wire pulling નકરો.

title.en: 1.3 Specification of wiring materials and accessories

h.en: Specification of wiring materials and accessories

body.en:
Definition

A specification is a written statement of the required technical characteristics,quality,performance and acceptance conditions of an item or work.

Explanation and application

  • For cable state conductor/core/area,voltage,insulation,installation/fire duty,length unit and applicable standard.For switches/sockets state pole/function,current,voltage,enclosure and terminals.
  • MCBbreaking capacity must suit prospective fault current;RCCBrated current and residual sensitivity are different quantities.DBspecification includes ways,phases,busbars,IP/enclosure and protective scheme.
  • List accessories separately when not included in the item rate:boxes,glands,lugs,bushes,saddles,labels and bonding.The syllabus laboratory ranges are examples,not mandatory sizes for all projects.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Specification એ item/workના જરૂરી technical characteristics,quality,performance/acceptance conditionsનું written statement છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Cable માટે conductor,cores,area,V,insulation,duty,unit/standard લખો.Switch-socket માટે function,poles,I,V,enclosure/terminals લો.
  • MCB breaking capacity fault current માટે યોગ્ય હોવી જોઈએ.RCCB rated I/residual sensitivity અલગ છે.DBમાં ways,phases,busbars,IP/protection scheme લો.
  • Item rateમાં નઆવતાં boxes,glands,lugs,bushes,saddles,labels/bonding અલગ લો.Syllabus lab ranges બધા projectsના mandatory sizes નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A wiring tool is equipment selected to measure,prepare,assemble or verify an electrical installation without introducing unacceptable damage or risk.

Explanation and application

  • Tape/marker establish route lengths;cutters and correctly set strippers prepare conductors without nicking strands;approved crimp tools and torque tools produce specified connections.
  • Screwdrivers,pliers,drills and pulling aids must suit insulation,mechanical duty and access;tool condition and correct bit/die matter more than appearance.
  • An approved voltage indicator with before/after proving supports safe dead verification.A neon screwdriver or noncontact indicator alone is not proof of isolation;measurement category and ratings must suit the task.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Wiring tool એ measurement,preparation,assembly/verification માટે યોગ્ય પસંદ કરેલું equipment છે જે unacceptable damage/risk નઉમેરે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Tape-marker route માપે.Cutter/stripper strands nick કર્યા વિના prepare કરે.Approved crimp/torque tools specified connection આપે.
  • Screwdriver,pliers,drill/pulling aid duty પ્રમાણે લો.Condition/correct bit-die મહત્વનાં છે.
  • Approved voltage indicatorને before-after prove કરીને dead verification કરો.Neon screwdriver/noncontact indicator એકલું isolation proof નથી.Category/ratings યોગ્ય લો.

body.en:
Definition

A one-way lighting circuit controls one load from one location using a switch in the line conductor;the neutral completes the load circuit and PEprotects exposed conductive parts where required.

Explanation and application

  • Lighting loads connect in parallel across their rated supply,not as an accidental series chain.Each branch uses the specified switching/protection.
  • A socket circuit supplies a removable appliance through a rated outlet and protective arrangements;socket current rating is not the connected load or permission to fit a larger breaker.
  • Bell,pushbutton and fan-regulator circuits use their appropriate voltage/type and manufacturer connections.LEDdrivers/electronic regulators are not interchangeable with old filament/inductive accessories.
  • Only isolated low-voltage training demonstrations are intended;PEis never used as normal return or switched as a control conductor.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

One-way lightingમાં line conductorના switchથી એક સ્થળેથી load control થાય.Neutral return અને જરૂરી exposed parts માટે PE હોય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Lighting loads rated supply પર parallel હોય;accidental series chain નહીં.દરેક branchમાં specified switch-protection લો.
  • Socket circuit rated outlet/protectionથી applianceને supply આપે.Socket rating એટલે actual load કે bigger breakerની permission નથી.
  • Bell,pushbutton/fan regulatorમાં યોગ્ય V-type/manufacturer connection લો.LEDdriver/electronic regulator બધા જૂના accessories સાથે interchangeable નથી.
  • માત્ર isolated low-V trainer demonstration કરો.PE normal return/control switch conductor નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Two SPDTswitches control one lamp from two positions by selecting between two traveller paths.

Explanation and application

  • The first common receives line;two travellers connect corresponding switch functions;the second common feeds the lamp,which returns to neutral.
  • Operating either switch changes the selected path and toggles the lamp state;actual terminal markings come from the switch manufacturer,not a guessed diagram number.
  • Keep PEcontinuous and distinguish a two-way SPDTswitch from a double-pole isolator;the names describe different functions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

બે SPDT switches બે traveller paths પસંદ કરીને એક lampને બે સ્થળેથી control કરે તે two-way lighting છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • First common line લે;travellers switch functions જોડે;second common lampને feed કરે અને lamp neutralમાં return થાય.
  • કોઈપણ switch બદલતાં path/lamp state toggle થાય.Terminal marking manufacturerથી લો,guess નકરો.
  • PE continuous રાખો.Two-way SPDT તથા double-pole isolator અલગ functions છે.

body.en:
Definition

The Electricity Act,2003is legislation governing the electricity sector;CEAregulations and applicable state/utility requirements provide specific safety and supply obligations.

Explanation and application

  • The syllabus phrase IEAct-2003should be read as Electricity Act,2003,not an Act titled Indian Electricity Rules2003.Legacy Indian Electricity Rules,1956are historical references,not a substitute for the current applicable framework.
  • CEA Safety and Electric Supply Regulations2023are the principal source referenced here.The gazetted2026amendment has a stated commencement of1April2027;publication does not mean already effective on1November2026.
  • The syllabus asks NEC2011;study it as the named edition.BISalso documents NEC2023.A later code edition and a legally applicable requirement must be checked rather than treated as identical automatically.
  • Core safety duties include suitable isolation/protection,earthing/bonding,competent authorised work,inspection/testing and records.Do not invent legal clause numbers,clearances or universal test limits.

Reference: [1](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/1362/simple-search?query=NLDC+Rules,+2004&searchradio=rules).

Reference: [5](https://egazette.gov.in/WriteReadData/2026/271455.pdf).

Reference: [1](https://www.bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/NEC-29-30-Sept.-Brochure.pdf).
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Electricity Act,2003 electricity sectorનો કાયદો છે.CEA regulations તથા applicable state-utility rules specific safety/supply obligations આપે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Syllabusનું IEAct-2003 એટલે Electricity Act,2003 સમજવું;Indian Electricity Rules2003 નામનો Act નહીં.Legacy1956 Rules current frameworkનો substitute નથી.
  • અહીં CEA Safety/Electric Supply Regulations2023 principal reference છે.Gazetted2026 amendment1April2027થી અમલ કહે છે;એથી1November2026એ already effective નમાનો.
  • Syllabus NEC2011ને તે edition તરીકે ભણો.BISમાં NEC2023 પણ documented છે.Later code/legal applicability ચકાસો;આપોઆપ identical નધારો.
  • Isolation,protection,earthing-bonding,competent authorised work,tests/records જરૂરી છે.Legal clause,clearance/universal limits કલ્પિત નકરો.

Reference: [1](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/1362/simple-search?query=NLDC+Rules,+2004&searchradio=rules).

Reference: [5](https://egazette.gov.in/WriteReadData/2026/271455.pdf).

Reference: [1](https://www.bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/NEC-29-30-Sept.-Brochure.pdf).

body.en:
Definition

Electrical estimation is the systematic forecast of quantities,resources and likely cost for a defined electrical work before execution,citing drawings,specifications,assumptions and rate basis.Costing assigns money to those resources and stated additions.

Explanation and application

  • Preliminary/rough estimate supports feasibility from a declared basis;detailed estimate uses designed quantities,item descriptions and rates.Revised estimate updates an earlier estimate when scope,quantities or costs change materially.
  • Supplementary estimate addresses additional work not in the original scope;repair/maintenance estimates address existing assets.Revised and supplementary can coexist when both conditions apply.
  • Workflow:survey→approved drawings/design→quantity take-off→BOQ→rate analysis→cost summary→checks/approval.Record revision,units,inclusions and exclusions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Electrical estimation એટલે execution પહેલાં defined workના drawings,specifications,assumptions/rates પરથી quantities,resources/સંભવિત costનો systematic અંદાજ.Costing એ resources/additionsને money value આપવાની પ્રક્રિયા છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Preliminary-rough feasibility માટે છે.Detailedમાં designed quantities/items/rates હોય.Revisedમાં scope,quantity/cost બદલાય ત્યારે જૂનો estimate update થાય.
  • Supplementary original scope બહારનું extra work છે.Repair-maintenance existing assets માટે છે.બંને changes હોય તો revised/supplementary સાથે થઈ શકે.
  • Survey→drawings-design→quantity→BOQ→rate analysis→summary→checks-approval લો.Revision,units/inclusions-exclusions લખો.

body.en:
Definition

A Schedule of Rates(SOR)is an identified dated schedule of descriptions,units and rates for specified work/items.A bill of quantities(BOQ)is the measured item list and quantities for a defined scope,which may then be priced.

Explanation and application

  • Check issuing authority,region,edition,date,unit and item inclusions:point wiring may already include wires,conduit,accessories and labour.Do not price them again unknowingly.
  • An item rate differs from a lump sum and from an assumed classroom unit rate.Market quotations need specification,manufacturer,quantity,validity,transport and tax basis.
  • Where no authentic SORor quote is supplied,label all rates assumed;never present an invented rupee value as the current government or Gujarat utility rate.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

SOR એ identified dated work/item descriptions,units/ratesનું schedule છે.BOQ એ defined scopeના measured items/quantitiesનું list છે,જેને rates આપી priced કરી શકાય.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Authority,region,edition,date,unit/inclusions ચકાસો.Point wiringમાં wires,conduit,accessories/labour included હોઈ શકે;ફરી double count નકરો.
  • Item rate,lump sum/classroom assumed rate અલગ છે.Quotationમાં spec,manufacturer,quantity,validity,transport/tax basis લો.
  • Authentic SOR-quote નમળે તો rates assumed લખો.Invented valueને current government/Gujarat utility rate નકહો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

For teaching only:material M₹10000,labour20%of M,contingency5%of direct cost and overhead/profit10%of direct plus contingency;taxes/fees excluded.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Labour=0.20M=₹2000;direct D=M+labour=₹12000.
  2. Contingency=0.05D=₹600;subtotal S=D+contingency=₹12600.
  3. Overhead/profit=0.10S=₹1260;total before excluded items=₹13860.

Interpretation and check

Percentages and their bases are assumed contractual choices,not statutory defaults.A cost definition must state taxes,utility fees,transport/testing and exclusions.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Teachingમાં M₹10000,labour Mના20%,contingency directના5% અને overhead-profit direct+contingencyના10% લો.Tax-fees excluded છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Labour=0.20M=₹2000/direct D=M+labour=₹12000 છે.
  2. Contingency=0.05D=₹600/subtotal S=₹12600 છે.
  3. Overhead-profit=0.10S=₹1260/total ₹13860 છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Percentages/bases assumed contract choices છે,statutory defaults નહીં.Tax,utility fees,transport-tests/exclusions લખો.

body.en:
Definition

An electrical works contract is an agreement,enforceable under applicable law,setting out the scope,quality,time,price/payment and obligations of parties;an estimate or quotation alone is not proof of a completed accepted installation.

Explanation and application

  • A tender invites offers against stated documents;the bidder checks drawings,specifications,BOQ,eligibility,validity,security,measurement and completion terms before pricing.
  • Rate analysis separates materials,labour,plant,transport,wastage/testing and agreed overhead/profit without double counting SORinclusions.Variations require the contract approval process.
  • Use genuine credentials,quotations and signatures;activity examples are drafts,not an authorised bid submission or legal guarantee.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Electrical works contract applicable law હેઠળ enforceable agreement છે,જે scope,quality,time,price-payment/obligations નક્કી કરે છે.ફક્ત estimate-quotation એટલે completed accepted installationનો proof નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Tender stated documents સામે offers મંગાવે.Bidder drawings,specs,BOQ,eligibility,validity,security/measurement-completion terms ચકાસે.
  • Rate analysisમાં material,labour,plant,transport,wastage-tests/OHP અલગ લો.SOR included વસ્તુ double count નકરો.Variation contract approvalથી થાય.
  • Genuine credentials,quotes/signatures જ વાપરો.Activity example draft છે;authorised bid/legal guarantee નથી.

body.en:
Aim and setup/data

Electrical wires and cables

Inspect de-energised labelled samples/datasheets;identify material,cores,area,insulation,voltage,armour/flexibility and permitted use.

Instruments/connections or study basis

Inspect de-energised labelled samples/datasheets;identify material,cores,area,insulation,voltage,armour/flexibility and permitted use.

Ordered safe procedure

  1. Identify supplied drawings,data,specifications,scope,source COand actual/assumed status;prepare a labelled diagram and blank record.
  2. Use dead samples or an approved isolated current-limited low-voltage trainer.Any field/live testing is restricted to qualified authorised personnel with the approved risk/isolation plan.
  3. Inspect de-energised labelled samples/datasheets;identify material,cores,area,insulation,voltage,armour/flexibility and permitted use.
  4. Check units,ratings,protective paths,design assumptions and item inclusions before calculation/inspection;never bypass protection or change live connections.
  5. Compare genuine specifications;do not infer ampacity from colour or diameter alone and do not cut unidentified cables.
  6. Record only actual observations or clearly labelled supplied/calculated data with source/date;unperformed readings and signatures remain blank.
  7. Review uncertainties,defects and exclusions;shut down/discharge/verify dead before any access or rewire and obtain authorised review before service.

Calculations,reporting and fault-finding

Inspect de-energised labelled samples/datasheets;identify material,cores,area,insulation,voltage,armour/flexibility and permitted use.

Compare genuine specifications;do not infer ampacity from colour or diameter alone and do not cut unidentified cables.

Precautions

No utility tampering,live domestic/motor installation,PEor RCDbypass,neon-only dead proof,unapproved earth disconnection or invented test certificates.Cables/capacitors and PV/UPS/generators can create backfeed/stored-energy hazards.

Actual record — blank

body.gu:
હેતુ તથા Setup/Data

Electrical Wires તથા Cables

Dead labelled samples/dataમાં material,cores,area,insulation,V,armour-flexibility/use ઓળખો.

Instruments/Connections અથવા Study Basis

Dead labelled samples/dataમાં material,cores,area,insulation,V,armour-flexibility/use ઓળખો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ Safe Procedure

  1. Drawings,data,specs,scope,source CO/actual-assumed status ઓળખી diagram/blank record બનાવો.
  2. Dead sample/approved isolated limited low-V trainer લો.Field-live test qualified authorised personnel approved planથી જ કરે.
  3. Dead labelled samples/dataમાં material,cores,area,insulation,V,armour-flexibility/use ઓળખો.
